meta.purpose: Demo: the pharmacogenetic genotypes of a fictional user.
meta.warning: SYNTHETIC. A fictional person; the data are generated by make_demo_profile.py and belong to nobody.
meta.source: Synthetic. In a real profile the genotypes are called from BAM/VCF rather than entered by hand.

genotypes.interpretation: Two non-functional *4 copies — a poor metaboliser: codeine and tramadol are not converted into the active form.
A *17 homozygote — a rapid metaboliser: proton pump inhibitors work more weakly than expected.
Factor V Leiden, heterozygous — an increased risk of venous thrombosis.
A homozygote; read together with homocysteine — 13.4 here against a limit of 10.
A non-secretor — affects the composition of the microbiota and the uptake of B12.

warfarin_summary: Demo: VKORC1 G/G with no CYP2C9 variants — the expected dose is the usual one; the calculation is the doctor's.

current_scheme_check.verdict: There are no genetic contraindications to the current demo scheme.
flags: A drug matter, not a genetic one: levothyroxine and omeprazole are taken at the same time — the absorption of the hormone drops. Space the doses apart.
To discuss with a doctor: heterozygous factor V Leiden against a combined oral contraceptive — a combination the doctor has to know about.

future_flags.why: CYP2D6 poor metaboliser — there will be no pain relief, a drug of another pathway is needed.
CYP2C19 *17/*17 — activation is enhanced; a separate conversation when it is prescribed.

hla.note: Demo: the four drug hypersensitivity alleles are absent.
